entries.zh: 遗留系统、老系统（l 开头的形容词）

examples.en: Most of the business rules lived in a legacy system that nobody fully understood.
examples.zh: 大部分业务规则都在一套没人完全搞懂的老系统里。

situation.zh: 面试官问：你们为什么不直接在原来的系统上加新功能？
situation.en: It was a fifteen-year-old legacy system with no tests, so every change was risky.

entries.note: legacy 作形容词，暗示“老、难改，但还在用”。也说 legacy code、legacy codebase。

entries.zh: 技术债

examples.en: We set aside one sprint per quarter to pay down technical debt.
examples.zh: 我们每个季度留出一个迭代来还技术债。

situation.zh: 面试官问：业务一直催功能，你们怎么处理积累下来的历史问题？
situation.en: I tracked the technical debt in a shared list and tied each item to the incidents it had caused.

entries.note: 口语常简称 tech debt。还债用 pay down 或 pay off，欠债用 take on 或 accumulate。debt 里的 b 不发音。

entries.zh: 从零重写、推倒重来（含 s 开头的名词）

examples.en: We decided not to rewrite it from scratch because the old code encoded years of fixes.
examples.zh: 我们决定不推倒重写，因为老代码里沉淀了多年的修补。

situation.zh: 面试官问：面对一个很烂的老系统，你倾向于重写还是重构？
situation.en: I'm cautious about rewriting from scratch. You usually underestimate how much behavior the old system has.

entries.note: from scratch 表示“从零开始”。一次性的大重写也叫 a big-bang rewrite，通常带贬义。

entries.zh: 渐进式重构、一点一点地重构（动词 + i 开头的副词）

examples.en: We chose to refactor incrementally, one module at a time, behind the same interface.
examples.zh: 我们选择渐进式重构，一次改一个模块，对外接口保持不变。

situation.zh: 面试官问：你们没有停下业务来重写，那老代码是怎么改善的？
situation.en: We refactored incrementally: each time we touched a module for a feature, we cleaned it up first.

entries.note: 重构（refactor）不改变外部行为，重写（rewrite）是另起炉灶。副词也可以换成 gradually。

entries.zh: 迁移路径（从旧方案过渡到新方案的步骤）

examples.en: We gave each client team a clear migration path from the old API to the new one.
examples.zh: 我们给每个调用方团队都提供了从旧接口迁到新接口的清晰路径。

situation.zh: 面试官问：新系统设计得很好，但几十个调用方怎么迁过来？
situation.en: We designed the migration path first: old and new ran side by side, and teams moved over one by one.

entries.zh: 双写（同时写新旧两套系统）

examples.en: During the migration, we did dual writes to both the old and the new database.
examples.zh: 迁移期间，我们对新旧两个数据库做双写。

situation.zh: 面试官问：数据迁移期间，新旧两边的数据怎么保持同步？
situation.en: We used dual writes: every change went to both systems, and we compared the results before switching reads.

entries.note: 作形容词时加连字符：a dual-write period。风险是两边写入不一致，所以要配合数据比对。

entries.zh: 把流量（逐步）切过去（s 开头的动词）

examples.en: We shifted traffic to the new service gradually, starting with one percent.
examples.zh: 我们把流量逐步切到新服务，从百分之一开始。

situation.zh: 面试官问：新老系统都在跑，你们是怎么把线上流量切过去的？
situation.en: We shifted traffic in stages, from one percent to ten to fifty, and watched the error rate at each step.

entries.note: “灰度切流”可以说 shift traffic gradually。也说 route a percentage of traffic to the new system。

entries.zh: （在某个时间点正式）切换到新系统（c 开头的短语动词，两个词）

examples.en: We cut over to the new billing system on a Sunday night, when traffic was lowest.
examples.zh: 我们选在周日晚上流量最低的时候，切换到新的计费系统。

situation.zh: 面试官问：最终把所有流量切到新系统那一步，你们是怎么安排的？
situation.en: We cut over region by region, and kept the old system on standby for two weeks.

entries.note: 名词写成一个词 cutover：The cutover went smoothly. 指从旧到新的那个切换时刻。

entries.zh: 功能对齐（新系统具备旧系统的全部功能），第二个词 p 开头

examples.en: The new system didn't reach feature parity with the old one for almost a year.
examples.zh: 新系统花了将近一年，才在功能上追平老系统。

situation.zh: 面试官问：重写项目为什么比预期多花了这么久？
situation.en: We underestimated feature parity. The old system had dozens of small behaviors nobody had documented.

entries.note: parity 的意思是“对等”。常用搭配是 reach / achieve feature parity with ...

entries.zh: （正式）下线、停用旧系统或旧服务器（d 开头的动词）

examples.en: We finally decommissioned the old order system six months after the migration.
examples.zh: 迁移完成六个月后，我们终于把老订单系统下线了。

situation.zh: 面试官问：流量都切走之后，老系统是马上关掉的吗？
situation.en: No, we kept it read-only for a quarter, and decommissioned it once nobody had queried it for a month.

entries.note: 指彻底关停并回收资源。口语也说 shut down、turn off、retire；sunset 多用于对外的产品或接口。

entries.zh: 不断变化的需求（c 开头的 -ing 形容词 + 复数名词）

examples.en: We kept the design flexible because we were dealing with changing requirements.
examples.zh: 我们把设计做得比较灵活，因为需求一直在变。

situation.zh: 面试官问：产品方向经常调整，你怎么避免做出来的东西白费？
situation.en: With changing requirements, I build the smallest thing that works and avoid committing to details too early.

entries.note: 单次的需求变更说 a requirement change 或 a change in requirements。也可以说 The requirements kept changing.

entries.zh: 范围蔓延（项目进行中需求不断悄悄加码）

examples.en: The project slipped by a month, mostly because of scope creep.
examples.zh: 项目延期了一个月，主要是因为需求范围不断膨胀。

situation.zh: 面试官问：项目做到一半，业务方不断往里加东西，你怎么处理？
situation.en: I stopped the scope creep by writing down what was in the first release and pushing the rest to later.

entries.note: creep 是“悄悄爬”的意思，带贬义：没人正式决定扩大范围，但它就是越来越大。

entries.zh: 最小可行产品（全称，三个词）

examples.en: We shipped a minimum viable product in six weeks to test the idea with real users.
examples.zh: 我们用六周上线了一个最小可行产品，拿真实用户来验证想法。

situation.zh: 面试官问：一个全新的业务，你们第一版是怎么定范围的？
situation.en: We started with a minimum viable product: one payment method, one country, and no admin UI.

entries.note: 平时几乎都说缩写 MVP，三个字母分开读。

entries.zh: （在现有版本上）反复迭代改进（i 开头的动词 + on）

examples.en: We launched a basic version and iterated on it based on what users actually did.
examples.zh: 我们先上了一个基础版，再根据用户的实际行为迭代。

situation.zh: 面试官问：第一版功能很粗糙，后来是怎么变好的？
situation.en: We iterated on it every two weeks, using support tickets and usage data to decide what to fix next.

entries.note: iterate on 后面接要改进的东西。名词 iteration 也可以指一个迭代周期。

entries.zh: 收集用户反馈（g 开头的动词）

examples.en: We gathered user feedback through interviews before we built the second version.
examples.zh: 做第二版之前，我们通过访谈收集了用户反馈。

situation.zh: 面试官问：你们怎么知道用户真正想要什么？
situation.en: We gathered user feedback from support tickets and customer calls, and the same three complaints kept coming up.

entries.note: feedback 不可数，不说 feedbacks 或 a feedback，要说 some feedback 或 a piece of feedback。动词也可以用 collect。

entries.zh: 做 A/B 测试（r 开头的动词）

examples.en: We ran an A/B test on the new checkout page before releasing it to everyone.
examples.zh: 新结算页全量之前，我们先做了一次 A/B 测试。

situation.zh: 面试官问：你们怎么判断新设计是不是真的比旧的好？
situation.en: We ran an A/B test for two weeks, with half of the users on each version.

entries.note: 也叫 split test 或 experiment。参与对比的每个版本叫 variant。

entries.zh: 对照组（实验里不做改动的那一组）

examples.en: The control group saw the old page, and the other group saw the new one.
examples.zh: 对照组看到的是旧页面，另一组看到的是新页面。

situation.zh: 面试官问：你说新推荐算法提升了点击率，是和什么比的？
situation.en: Compared with the control group, which kept the old algorithm over the same two weeks.

entries.note: 做了改动的那一组叫 treatment group 或 test group。

entries.zh: 统计上显著的（副词 + 形容词）

examples.en: The difference looked good, but it wasn't statistically significant yet.
examples.zh: 差异看起来不错，但在统计上还不显著。

situation.zh: 面试官问：实验跑了三天，数据已经更好了，为什么不直接全量？
situation.en: The sample was too small, so the result wasn't statistically significant. We let it run for two more weeks.

entries.note: 名词是 statistical significance：reach statistical significance（达到统计显著）。

entries.zh: 转化率

examples.en: The new flow improved the checkout conversion rate from 62 to 68 percent.
examples.zh: 新流程把结算转化率从 62% 提高到了 68%。

situation.zh: 面试官问：这次改版，你们用什么指标衡量成功？
situation.en: Our main metric was the conversion rate: the share of users who started checkout and actually paid.

entries.note: 动词是 convert：Only 3% of visitors convert. 相关指标：retention rate 留存率，churn rate 流失率，click-through rate 点击率。

entries.zh: 衡量（改动带来的）实际效果（m 开头的动词 + i 开头的名词）

examples.en: We added tracking before launch so we could measure the impact afterwards.
examples.zh: 我们在上线前就加了埋点，这样上线后才能衡量效果。

situation.zh: 面试官问：功能上线之后，你们怎么知道它到底有没有用？
situation.en: We measured the impact by comparing order completion in the four weeks before and after the launch.

entries.note: impact 后面接 on：measure the impact on revenue。“埋点”可以说 tracking 或 instrumentation。

entries.zh: 权限模型

examples.en: Our permission model was based on roles, resources, and actions.
examples.zh: 我们的权限模型建立在角色、资源和操作这三者之上。

situation.zh: 面试官问：企业客户的组织结构各不相同，你们的权限是怎么设计的？
situation.en: We redesigned the permission model so customers could define their own roles instead of using fixed ones.

entries.note: permission 是具体的一项权限，可数：grant a permission。access 是访问权，不可数：have access to the report。

entries.zh: 给（用户）分配角色（a 开头的动词）

examples.en: Admins can assign a role to each user at the project level.
examples.zh: 管理员可以在项目级别给每个用户分配角色。

situation.zh: 面试官问：同一个用户在不同项目里权限不同，这个怎么支持？
situation.en: We assign a role to the user per project, so the same person can be an admin in one and a viewer in another.

entries.note: 常见的角色名：admin、editor、viewer、owner。也说 assign users to a role。

entries.zh: 审批流（第二个词 w 开头）

examples.en: We built a configurable approval workflow for purchase orders above a certain amount.
examples.zh: 我们为超过一定金额的采购单做了一套可配置的审批流。

situation.zh: 面试官问：你做过的企业软件里，哪块业务逻辑最复杂？
situation.en: The approval workflow. Each customer wanted different steps, different approvers, and different rules for skipping levels.

entries.note: 审批人是 approver，提交审批是 submit for approval，待审批是 pending approval，驳回是 reject。

entries.zh: 多租户的（形容词，带连字符）

examples.en: It's a multi-tenant system, so every query has to be scoped to the customer's account.
examples.zh: 这是个多租户系统，所以每条查询都必须限定在该客户的账号范围内。

situation.zh: 面试官问：你们的 SaaS 产品，不同客户的数据是怎么隔离的？
situation.en: It's multi-tenant with a shared database, and every table has a tenant ID that we filter on.

entries.note: 租户是 tenant，租户隔离是 tenant isolation。每个客户独立部署一套叫 single-tenant。名词是 multi-tenancy。

entries.zh: 生成报表（g 开头的动词）

examples.en: It took twenty minutes to generate a report for our largest customers.
examples.zh: 给最大的那几个客户生成一份报表要二十分钟。

situation.zh: 面试官问：报表查询把线上数据库拖慢了，你们怎么解决的？
situation.en: We moved it off the main database. Now we generate reports from a read replica in a background job.

entries.note: 定时报表是 scheduled report，临时拉的报表是 ad hoc report，报表功能统称 reporting。

entries.zh: 国际化（让产品能支持多语言、多地区的工程工作，全称）

examples.en: We added internationalization late, so we had to pull hard-coded strings out of every page.
examples.zh: 我们国际化做得晚，结果不得不把每个页面里写死的文案都抽出来。

situation.zh: 面试官问：产品要进入日本和德国市场，前端最大的工作量是什么？
situation.en: Internationalization: extracting all the text, handling plurals and date formats, and making layouts work with longer strings.

entries.note: 常缩写成 i18n（首尾字母之间有 18 个字母）。它是让产品“能够”适配各地；localization（l10n）是针对某个地区做具体的翻译和适配。

entries.zh: 夏令时（三个词）

examples.en: The scheduled job ran twice because of daylight saving time.
examples.zh: 因为夏令时，那个定时任务跑了两次。

situation.zh: 面试官问：时区处理里，你踩过什么坑？
situation.en: Daylight saving time. Once a year a local hour doesn't exist, and once a year it happens twice.

entries.note: 标准写法是 saving，不带 s，口语里很多人说 savings。缩写 DST。通用做法：存 UTC，展示时再转成用户的本地时间。

entries.zh: 批量导入（b 开头）

examples.en: The bulk import had to handle files with over a million rows.
examples.zh: 批量导入要能处理超过一百万行的文件。

situation.zh: 面试官问：客户要一次性导入几十万条历史数据，你们怎么做的？
situation.en: We built a bulk import that runs in the background, validates each row, and returns a file of the rows that failed.

entries.note: bulk 表示“大批量的”：bulk update、bulk delete、in bulk。

entries.zh: 导出 CSV 文件的功能（名词短语，两个词）

examples.en: The CSV export timed out for large accounts, so we made it asynchronous.
examples.zh: 大客户的 CSV 导出会超时，所以我们把它改成了异步。

situation.zh: 面试官问：用户点“导出”要等好几分钟，你们怎么改进的？
situation.en: We turned the CSV export into a background job and emailed the user a download link when it was ready.

entries.note: 动词说法：export the data to CSV。CSV 三个字母分开读。

entries.zh: 信息流（社交产品首页不断刷新的内容列表）

examples.en: We precomputed each user's news feed so the home page would load quickly.
examples.zh: 我们预先算好每个用户的信息流，这样首页加载才快。

situation.zh: 面试官问：用户打开首页看到的内容列表，是实时算的还是提前算好的？
situation.en: For most users we build the news feed ahead of time, and we only compute it on read for very active accounts.

entries.note: 也简称 feed，或叫 timeline（时间线）。

entries.zh: 个性化推荐（复数）

examples.en: Personalized recommendations drove about a third of our orders.
examples.zh: 个性化推荐带来了我们大约三分之一的订单。

situation.zh: 面试官问：新用户没有任何行为数据，首页给他推什么？
situation.en: We can't show personalized recommendations yet, so we show what's popular in their region instead.

entries.note: 新用户没数据的问题叫 the cold start problem（冷启动问题）。推荐系统是 recommendation system 或 recommender。

entries.zh: 推送通知（发到手机通知栏的那种）

examples.en: We batch push notifications so users don't get ten alerts in a minute.
examples.zh: 我们把推送通知合并发送，免得用户一分钟收到十条提醒。

situation.zh: 面试官问：通知发得太多，用户直接把通知权限关了，你们怎么办？
situation.en: We let users choose which push notifications they get, and we cap how many we send per day.

entries.note: 应用内的通知叫 in-app notification，邮件通知叫 email notification。

entries.zh: 未读数（图标上显示的未读消息条数）

examples.en: The unread count on the app icon was often out of sync with the inbox.
examples.zh: 应用图标上的未读数经常和收件箱里的对不上。

situation.zh: 面试官问：消息的已读未读状态，在多端之间怎么保持一致？
situation.en: We keep the unread count on the server and push updates to every device when a message is marked as read.

entries.note: 标为已读是 mark as read，已读回执是 read receipt，图标上的角标叫 badge。

entries.zh: 内容审核（m 开头）

examples.en: We combined automated filters with human review for content moderation.
examples.zh: 内容审核方面，我们把自动过滤和人工复审结合起来。

situation.zh: 面试官问：用户发的帖子和图片，公开之前要不要过一遍检查？
situation.en: Yes. Content moderation runs before a post goes public, and anything borderline goes to a human reviewer.

entries.note: 审核员是 moderator，举报内容是 report 或 flag a post，下架是 take down。不要说 content audit，那是“盘点内容”的意思。
